name: grandpa
notes: v1 athlete, used for both players. Strength/speed/flexibility are multiples of a trained adult (Blueprint section 1). Toughness = KO resistance: multiplies the neck motors' strength on top of strength (a tougher athlete braces the head; the same slap snaps it less). Fatigue (match only, resets each match): stamina drops by stamina_per_strike for every turn struck (joint speed x stamina, floor 0.7); the neck motors' strength drops by neck_damage_per_snap per m/s of head snap absorbed (floor 0.5).

style.summary: Balance: upright and straight-legged, arms hanging. Slap: big and loopy - a long trunk wind-up and a full arm swing (his reference slap, found by search from the default guess).
